problem:
Title: Equations defining Projection in Plane/Cartesian

Let $M$ and $N$ be distinct [[Definition:Straight Line|lines]] in [[Definition:The Plane|the plane]], both of which pass through the [[Definition:Origin|origin]].

Let the [[Definition:Plane Angle|angle]] between $M$ and the [[Definition:X-Axis|$x$-axis]] be $\theta$.

Let the [[Definition:Plane Angle|angle]] between $N$ and the [[Definition:X-Axis|$x$-axis]] be $\phi$.

Let $\pr_{M, N}$ be the '''[[Definition:Projection in Plane|projection on $M$ along $N$]]''':
:$\forall P \in \R^2: \map {\pr_{M, N} } P =$ the [[Definition:Intersection (Geometry)|intersection]] of $M$ with the line through $P$ [[Definition:Parallel Lines|parallel]] to $N$.

Let $P = \tuple {x, y}$ be an arbitrary [[Definition:Point|point]] in [[Definition:The Plane|the plane]].

Then:
:$\map {\pr_{M, N} } P = \begin {cases} 
\tuple {0, y - x \tan \phi} & : \theta = \dfrac \pi 2 \\
\tuple {x, x \tan \theta} & : \phi = \dfrac \pi 2 \\
\tuple {\dfrac {x \tan \phi} {\tan \phi - \tan \theta} - \dfrac y {\tan \phi - \tan \theta}, \dfrac {y \tan \theta} {\tan \theta - \tan \phi} - \dfrac {x \tan \theta \tan \phi} {\tan \theta - \tan \phi} } & : \text {otherwise} 
\end {cases}$
